description:
Produce the synthetic loads enumerated in N-008 §5. The matrix locks the spec; this ticket produces the runnable artefacts (binaries, scripts, operator notes) that the runner harness (T-010a) and the RC executor (T-010c) consume.

In scope (one deliverable per load, binding):
- L-MOTION-60 — full-screen smooth horizontal scroll, 60 fps frame-perfect, with an EMBEDDED FRAME COUNTER (PTS encoded in pixels). The frame counter is load-bearing for the no-fake-duplicated-frames check (N-008 §6.1, VAL-EXP-010, VAL-REG-002) and for cadence verification (N-008 §6.1). Spec discipline: each rendered frame must encode its source-side frame index in pixel data so that ffprobe -show_frames followed by an external decoder can verify monotonic increase and exact frame count. Acceptable form: a fullscreen test page driven by a dedicated launcher, OR a compiled GL widget. Whichever form, a single `make` (or equivalent) target builds the asset; documented in N-008 §5 terms.
- L-STATIC — static desktop with a single small 1 Hz blinking indicator. Tests idle path and GOP keyframe correctness.
- L-CHANGE — 5 s static → 5 s motion → 5 s static, repeating. Tests dynamic bitrate and segment boundary stability.
- L-RESIZE — operator script that resizes the source window once mid-capture (manual; document the wmctrl/kdotool incantation per compositor in N-008 §4 M1..M4).
- L-MINIMIZE — operator script that minimises or fully covers the source window for 60 s. Load-bearing for VAL-CAP-006 (Issue #3 absorption proof per N-008 §17).
- L-PORTAL-DENY — operator note (manual click on Cancel in the portal dialog). Document the expected reason code (`portal-denied`) and the FSM transition (PICKING again per VAL-CAP-003).
- L-SOURCE-REMOVE — scripted-local where possible (wmctrl close on a known title) with manual fallback. Document expected `source-removed` reason and FSM `SESSION_LOST`.
- L-COMP-PAUSE — operator note: trigger screensaver / compositor blank for ≥ 30 s. Per-compositor instructions for KDE Plasma (M1, M3), GNOME (M2), wlroots/Sway (M4).
- L-DISK-SLOW — scripted-local. dm-delay-throttled mount producing a 50 MB/s ceiling. Setup + teardown shell scripts. Documented sudo requirements.
- L-DISK-FULL — scripted-local. 200 MiB tmpfs mount as the segment dir. Setup + teardown shell scripts. Tests the `segment-sink-disk-full` reason and FSM SESSION_LOST per N-008 §6.
- L-CRASH-CAP — scripted-local. SIGKILL the helper mid-capture. Documented PID lookup (pgrep cove-replay-engine -u $UID) and timing.
- L-CRASH-EXP — scripted-local. SIGKILL the helper mid-export. Documented PID lookup and timing window (between export.started and export.completed).

Out of scope (binding):
- L-AUDIO-SYNC — placeholder for the audio milestone (N-008 §6.9). NOT in v2.0.0 video-only GA.
- Runner integration — T-010a wires the loads into the harness.
- Execution on the matrix — T-010c.
- Any change to the helper or Electron source code.
- Compositor-specific HUD overlays beyond what the load itself needs to display the embedded frame counter.

Acceptance:
- L-MOTION-60 produces a frame stream where (a) the embedded frame counter increments monotonically by 1 per source frame, (b) at 60 fps the runtime can read back the counter from a captured MP4 to verify cadence to within ±0.5 % mean / ±2 % 95p / ±5 % 99p (N-008 §6.1), (c) at known capture durations the frame count predictably matches `round(duration_s × 60) ± 1`.
- All scripted-local loads can be invoked by the runner harness (T-010a) through a single shell entrypoint per load (no interactive prompts).
- All manual loads have a one-page operator procedure per compositor (M1..M4) listing exact steps and expected helper events.
- A README enumerates the loads, their tier, their target row(s) in N-008 §§8–14, and their setup/teardown.

Dependencies on other tickets:
- Spec only — N-008 §5 is authoritative. This ticket does not consume T-010a's runner; the loads are stand-alone CLI artefacts. T-010a may wrap them.

No commits, tags, or publishes from this ticket.
